entries.title: LILIUM — flower as a family of images
entries.creator: yuk.aji (credited by Motionimo repost)
entries.summary: One flower links full silhouette, petal macros, anatomy and graphic masks. Transfer related views and scale changes; omit specimen labels for a hero-only brief.

evidence.method: Decoded frame sequences; no complete normal-speed audiovisual review
evidence.scope: Decoded 6.76 s repost, 1280×720, 202 video frames at 30 fps; sampled at 3 fps. Original creator publication and source files not independently verified.
observed_beats: 0–0.7 s: flower silhouette and grid
1–2 s: petal macro and pixel masks
2–3.7 s: red field and related flower details
3.7–4.7 s: enlarged deforming type
4.7–6.7 s: flower returns through alternate graphic states

mechanism.preserved_property: Flower identity and a restricted red/black/white/cyan visual language.
mechanism.original_transfer: An original shell alternates full silhouette, ridge macro and interior spiral; a ridge mask carries the cut.

entries.limitations: Reference type and annotation belong to the observed composition and should only inform a new brief when relevant

entries.title: Day 01/30 — icon becomes a usable player

entries.summary: A music icon becomes a physical player, appears in a hand and settles into a tabletop context. Each new representation reveals another use relationship.

evidence.method: Decoded frame sequences; no complete normal-speed audiovisual review
evidence.scope: Decoded 11.38 s repost, 1280×720, 340 video frames at 30 fps; sampled at 2 fps. Source project and production tools unknown.
observed_beats: 0–2.3 s: music icon selection
2.5–3.7 s: icon becomes a white/silver player
3.8–6.3 s: hand and song-selection interaction
6.5 s onward: released player settles on a table

mechanism.preserved_property: Recognizable music/device identity across representation changes.
mechanism.original_transfer: An original seed symbol becomes a seed capsule, splits at a seam and releases its seed; the same contour survives each state.

entries.limitations: Logos screen artwork hand footage and music remain reference material requiring separate authorization for reuse
